Good evening, I saw your SD illustration and thought it was so cute...! I saw an SD illustration and thought it was really cute...!
She is a transforming heroine named "Metelite Lumiera", and the following design materials have been approved for use in your request.

Design description
Please refer to the URL at the bottom for the main design.
The following are characteristic elements.
The motif of her personality and atmosphere is "friendly, kind, cute, and neat". She is a pure and straight girl of high school age.
She has long, slender eyelashes and a girlish to slightly mature face.
Her eyes are highlighted with yellow stars.
The hair ornament, tiara, and white fluffy ornaments on her head are all attached independently.
The back of her hair is gathered inward at the neck, and then parted outward around her back. The silhouette of the mid-back hair is intended to look like the wings of an angel.
The dress on the torso and the ruffles on the arms are independent decorations.
The long skirt of the dress is gradated from red to pale pink toward the bottom.
The front side of the white mini-skirt is decorated with three-tiered white ribbons and pearls at both ends.
We will leave all unknown points, omission or simplification of costumes and decorations to you.

[Composition and pose]
SD illustrations as specified during the appeal, please!
Detailed interpretations of the above designs and methods of expression are left up to us. We will also leave all composition and poses up to you.
The general atmosphere we would like to see is that of a cute Lumieira-chan!

Usage
I would like to add the illustration to my Twitter moment. I may also use it for icons and headers.
The illustration may be quoted when making a request to a third party using the above moments.

Other
We would like to receive the illustration in PSD format. We have PSD viewing environment.

Thank you very much for your time and consideration.
